backbone.name: efficientnet-b0
backbone.preprocess: resize shorter side to 256 (bicubic), center crop 224, ImageNet mean/std; embedding = global-average-pooled conv features (1280-d); TTA = original + horizontal flip

head.type: multinomial logistic regression on standardized embeddings

manual_fallback.rule: наименьший порог, при котором на val точность среди принятых >= 0.75 и покрытие >= 0.4
manual_fallback.meaning: if max class probability < tau the UI must ask the user to choose severity manually

limitations: only severity is predicted; damaged parts are NOT predicted (the dataset has no part labels)
severity labels are subjective and the source dataset has no stated annotation protocol or license
validation/test sets are small (139 / 167 images): see confidence intervals in metrics.json
